description: Three entities acted in coordination within a 2-minute window: (1) IAM user 'dev-intern-jpark' queried IAM role policies, (2) service account 'svc-deploy-prod' accessed '/admin/users/export' from IP 10.200.1.8, and (3) an unknown principal 'svc-unknown-actor' attempted to assume the role 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dev-intern-jpark-role'. The timing suggests an orchestrated multi-actor attack.
